scope: Prospective TRAIN-only assertion-operator variation after exposed DEV audit76. Data preparation only; no model fitting or automatic admission.
parent_selection: Existing recovered TRAIN only, controlled_composition_v8 with exact original source hash, payload and labels. One original parent per language, normalized quoted core and full gold-world tuple, choosing lowest source-row digest. No selection by errors or held-out text.
matched_control: Repeat each selected original input eight times with the same paired identities, labels, contexts and factors. A future fitting comparison must match sample count, initialization, order, objective and update budget; do not confuse added repetitions with wording treatment.
invariants: Exact quoted core, surrounding subject/time clauses and every earlier turn remain unchanged.
All six parent attributes and binary disposition remain unchanged.
No reserved TEST inputs are read. Existing exposed TRAIN/DEV focal strings are used only for exact-overlap rejection.
No modification of active65 or queued73.
Core and family counts, repetition and imperfect synthetic provenance must be reported.
validation: Before fitting, independently recover parents, conserve all labels/context/core, recount complete treatment/control records and descriptor balance, reproduce artifact bytes, check all runtime tokens and fixed prefix. Structural tests are not semantic or language validation.
label_quality: Operators are assistant-authored intended equivalences. Source gold labels and cross-language wording are not independently annotated. Preserve this limitation and inspect all operator families and represented contexts before a prospective fitting decision.
novelty: This is a controlled augmentation experiment, not a new learning algorithm. Earlier scope/query studies20,22–24,30,33 failed qualification and remain retained.
